feature: Story-level answer lock and parent-friendly teacher assessment
workflow: Answer all ten response activities; incomplete slots, blanks or statements keep Lock in hidden.
Lock complete responses, including incorrect answers, as an immutable snapshot.
Show Call your teacher and require teacher code 259 for review.
Review questions, actual answers and expected answers; add optional name, support and parent note.
Save one-page PDF or 1600 x 2264 PNG; cancel/failure preserves the locked work and keeps Start something new disabled until an export is ready.
Start something new returns to the main All adventures landing page; the previous assessment and picture ID remain saved.
